definitions.explanation: A ticket or slip confirming a reservation, such as for a restaurant, event, or product pickup.

examples.japanese: {予約券|よやくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{予約券|よやくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}して→提示する：26842_teijisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please present your reservation slip at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予約券|よやくけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At popular restaurants, you sometimes can't get in without a reservation ticket.

notes:
A physical or digital ticket that proves a reservation has been made. Common at hospitals (as a numbered waiting slip), popular restaurants (for walk-in queuing systems), and events. Composed of ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約券|よやくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get a reservation ticket
- {予約券|よやくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue a reservation ticket
- {予約券|よやくけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: reservation ticket number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整理券|せいりけん}→整理券：08288_seiriken⟧: numbered ticket — a queuing ticket distributed in order of arrival, common on buses and at busy venues
- {予約確認書|よやくかくにんしょ}: reservation confirmation — a more formal document confirming a booking, often used for hotels or flights
- ⟦{引換券|ひきかえけん}→引換券：19009_hikikaeken⟧: redemption ticket — a voucher for exchanging or picking up goods
